rationale.complete: Round 1 done: card, impostor table and dated predictions before data; real-skeleton synthetic (pinned, Goldstone, regenerating and contrast worlds; Amendment 1); replication on 8 periods with two natives (#38 lag profile, #35 forks) in two models and three variants; 46 estimates rows; post hoc leave-one-out and split-size checks; confirm.py frozen (SHA-256) with a dry run, not run.
rationale.faithfulness: The noise-corrected persistence estimator is unbiased in every synthetic world and the pre-registered contrast passes in both models (R_D 4.7, 5.2; CI lower bound 2.1). It rests on one long fielded week (without #38 R_D 1.4 in bge), Goldstone's own size dependence confounds the field reading, and the fork week fails. Scorecard A1 B1 C1 D1 E1 F2 G1 H1 I0.
rationale.usefulness: Descriptive: room content directions keep most of their orientation day to day, and room-specific instructions held one fixed for three weeks. No lever with an effect size.

one_line: Inside a week the room content direction persists (cosine 0.69-0.95), more under room-specific instructions (pooled 0.93 vs 0.70, R_D 4.7), but the contrast rests on #38 and is confounded with split size.
